Package com.ucm.server.gameobjects

Class Player

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.server.gameobjects.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayerActions, IPlayerInfo
public class Player extends Object implements IPlayerActions
Abstract class that represents a player in the poker game.

A player has an identifier, a name and a certain amount of money that is divided into:

  • Money that has not been bet yet
  • Money currently in play (bet)

The player also has a role during each hand (see PlayerRole), a set of cards (maximum of two) and several state flags such as fold, all-in or elimination.

This class provides the base implementation of common poker actions and game notifications, while delegating decision-making logic to subclasses.

    • makePlay

      public String makePlay(int sb, int bb, int maxBet, int minRaise) throws IOException, TurnTimeoutException
      This method is called to notify the player about the current state of the game and to request an action. It measures the time taken by the player to respond and stores it in the player's experimental data.
      Parameters:
      sb - small blind amount
      bb - big blind amount
      maxBet - maximum bet amount in the current round
      minRaise - minimum raise amount in the current round
      Returns:
      the action chosen by the player, which can be "call", "raise ", "fold", "check", "small-blind", "big-blind", or "all-in"
      Throws:
      IOException - if there is an error in the communication with the player
      TurnTimeoutException - if the player takes too long to respond

      public int putSmallBlindBet(int sb) throws IOException
      Places the small blind bet for the player, deducting it from their off-bet money and adding it to their on-bet money. This method also updates the last command executed by the player to indicate that they have placed a small blind bet.
